statement: an fs transformation to the /etc node itself must not be admitted either (closes the hole of protecting only what's under it while letting the parent through) (sem: SEM-gx-gate-325)
why: the one input the disjunct `resource.locator == "/etc"` that hand 5 added protects. The glob `like "/etc/*"` does not match the node itself, so if the disjunct disappears the pack reverts to refusing /etc/passwd while letting a wholesale replacement of /etc through. (sem: SEM-gx-gate-326)

control.note: the refusal boundary is 'the node /etc', not 'a string starting with /etc'. A one-character-different control where both == and like are false; goes red if the pack widens to a prefix match (sem: SEM-gx-gate-327)
